svg.title: Kept NWS forecasts minus KPMV's reports, Oct 13, 2026 to Oct 22, 2026
svg.desc: Histograms of forecast minus reported wind speed, gust and direction at three issuance leads. Hours counted per bin; the dashed line is zero.
svg.text: Kept NWS forecasts minus KPMV's reports, Oct 13, 2026 to Oct 22, 2026
Hours per bin. Right of the dashed line the forecast was above the report, left of it below.
Rows: the newest issuance at least 0, 6 and 24 hours before the hour.

Speeds in whole knots, as a METAR reports. Direction only where the report gave one (not calm or variable). Source: docs/kept-forecasts-vs-kpmv.md, scripts/windErrorsData.ts.
